run_remote_decode: run remote VAE decode on a torch tensor at a Hugging Face Hybrid Inference endpoint
run_remote_encode: run remote VAE encode on a PIL image or torch tensor at a Hugging Face Hybrid Inference endpoint
prepare_decode_request: prepare a decode request with tensor data, headers, and parameters for remote VAE decoding
postprocess_decode_response: postprocess a remote decode response into PIL images, torch tensors, or MP4 bytes
detect_image_type: detect image file type from raw bytes by checking magic numbers for jpeg, png, gif, or bmp
